properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 15 at 4:35PM EDT until September 15 at 5:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
SMWMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Chokoloskee to Bonita Beach FL out 20 NM...
Coastal waters from East Cape Sable to Chokoloskee FL out 20 NM...

* Until 500 PM EDT.

* At 434 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located over Chokoloskee, moving west at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Chevelier Bay and Chokoloskee.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or the National Weather
Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 15 at 3:30PM CDT until September 16 at 3:30PM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...Adair County in southwestern Iowa...

* WHEN...Until 330 PM CDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 326 PM CDT, Emergency management reported numerous closed
roads in the warned area, with water nearing Highway 25 south of
Greenfield. Flooding is already occurring. Between 2 and 4 inches
of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in the
warned area through the overnight hours. Impacted streams include
the Middle River.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Greenfield, Stuart, Adair, Fontanelle, Orient, Bridgewater,
Greenfield Municipal Airport and Nodaway Park.
- This includes Interstate 80 between mile markers 73 and 96.
properties.instruction:
Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

For the latest stream observations and forecasts refer to
weather.gov/desmoines/water.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 15 at 2:24PM MDT until September 15 at 5:30PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Garfield County in west central Colorado...

* Until 530 PM MDT.

* At 224 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.4 and 0.8 inches of
rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 0.5 to 1.5 inches
in 1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Glenwood Springs, Carbondale and Cattle Creek.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

The Highway 82 corridor is prone to rockslides and mudslides in heavy
rain. Stay alert for rocks and debris on roads, and avoid driving on
flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 15 at 1:42PM MDT until September 15 at 4:45PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Kane County in southern Utah...

* Until 445 PM MDT.

* At 142 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across Buckskin Gulch, Wire Pass, and the Wave. Up to
0.75 inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks, streams, slot
canyons, and normally dry washes.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Buckskin Gulch, Wire Pass, and the Wave.

This includes US Route 89 between mile markers 14 and 27.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Dry
washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 4:45 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 4:45 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
